rules.tower: 100 floors on the original ten free-battle preset tiers, opponents picked from the floor number alone (no RNG), climbed in order; first clears pay crystal points, a chest every 5th floor (crystals + 1 ticket), a guardian prize every 10th (+2 tickets, 100 diamonds via the dia:tower:N ledger key); never Bits
rules.patrol: 120 + 38 x best floor crystal points an hour, up to 12 hours; the first collect starts it; a clock set backwards restarts it unpaid; one free two-hour quick patrol per local day
rules.battle: a floor is a Free Battle (mode 2) against its presets with no entry fee or payout; Sync bonuses uncapped; Sync EXP as a Free Battle
